items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.desc: Souls 9,600-30,400 (levels 16-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Ira Domini T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Hex-Lined Snap Trap, damage) grows from 116 to 223.

sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Battle Vest.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their carry dives you while you throw.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keep landing on you.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you've got no way out.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They chain stuns on you every time you go in.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 30,400 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Your grenade, Gutshot and ult all scale with weapon damage. Sell Hollow Point for this.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
